title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction and Acceptance of Litigation Cases Related to the Regulatory Functions of Stock Exchanges

articles.content_en: I. In accordance with the relevant provisions of Article 37 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 22 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Intermediate People's Courts in the localities where the Shanghai Stock Exchange and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange are located shall respectively have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and administrative cases related to the regulatory functions of the stock exchanges where the Shanghai Stock Exchange or the Shenzhen Stock Exchange is the defendant or a third party.

III. Where an investor files a lawsuit against an act taken by a stock exchange in the course of performing its regulatory duties concerning securities issuers and their related persons, members of the stock exchange and their related persons, or securities listing and trading activities that does not directly involve the interests of the investor, the People's Court shall not accept the case.
IV. These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
